# Responses adapter sources

Copied from the npm distribution of [dsh-plugin-chatgpt 0.1.18](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-chatgpt/v/0.1.18). The MIT notice is included in this directory. Local changes are limited to the SIWC request format, model visibility, error handling, and removal of source map references. OAuth, credential storage, DSH integration, and the Codex backend are implemented in the parent package.
